findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "signup" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: signup_create, signup_claim_access, signup_status · Private data: signup_create, signup_claim_access, signup_status · Public sink: signup_create, signup_claim_access · Destructive: signup_claim_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: signup_create, signup_claim_access, signup_status · Private data: signup_create, signup_claim_access, signup_status · Public sink: signup_create, signup_claim_access · Destructive: signup_claim_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
